subject: ClearPeak POC — multiprong incentive request (credits + short-term discount)
messages:
From: Erin Gallagher <erin.gallagher@clearpeak.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearpeak.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood trial — ask for top-up + short pilot discount

Hi Logan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited by the latency and inference costs we saw in the sandbox. We can run an internal eval next week if we get a small extension and more credits: our initial token burn estimate is higher than expected because we’re testing multi-turn flows across multiple model variants.

Can Redwood do the following for the ClearPeak POC?
- Top up trial credits by 40K tokens (we can provide a brief runbook of test scenarios)
- Extend the trial window by 21 days to finish performance tests
- Provide a one-time 15% listed-price discount for the first month after converting to committed usage (we’re aiming for a 12-month commit after successful POC)

We understand approvals are needed for anything beyond standard credits — happy to share more usage detail if that helps. If possible, include a simple MSA draft we can review with legal.

Best,
Erin
Erin Gallagher
Head of Platform Engineering
ClearPeak AI

Attachments: clearpeak-poc-scope.pdf (attached)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Redwood trial — ask for top-up + short pilot discount

Team — forwarding ClearPeak's ask. Quick summary: good strategic prospect (platform-first startup, likely $350-900k ARR depending on model selection). Their engineering lead wants a 40K token top-up, a 3-week extension, and a 15% introductory discount for month 1 post-conversion.

Preliminary numbers in the attached internal-concession-calculation_v2.xlsx show: incremental cost to us (GPU + infra) for the credits/top-up is ~ $1.8k, and the first-month discount at 15% on expected run rate equates to ~$6k in forgone revenue but materially increases conversion probability.

Recommendation (my ask to approvals):
- Approve one-time 40K credit top-up tied to a final success criteria doc
- Approve a 21-day trial extension
- Approve a 15% discount for the first billing month post-conversion, conditional on a signed 12-month commit within 30 days of POC completion

Risks/controls: require DPA + data retention limits, limit credits to the POC project id, and include monitoring hooks in the Console to detect abuse. Also recommend we require a short technical intake (one-pager) from ClearPeak describing the multi-turn flows and expected token burn.

I think this is within a margin we can absorb for an enterprise conversion opportunity. Marissa / Naomi — could you weigh in for final signoff? If you want, I can present the numbers to revenue ops.

Thanks,
Logan

Attachments: internal-concession-calculation_v2.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood trial — ask for top-up + short pilot discount

Logan — thanks for the summary and the calc. I’m comfortable approving the ask with the following guardrails:

1) Credits: 40K one-time top-up, limited to project id "clearpeak-poc-2026" and expire 30 days after POC end date.
2) Trial extension: 21 days maximum, no further extensions unless there is clear progress against success metrics.
3) Discount: 15% for month 1 only, conditional on a signed 12-month commitment within 30 days of POC completion and a minimum committed monthly spend of $12k.
4) Legal: require DPA + security questionnaire completion (they have SOC2 Type II in progress) — legal should review the Draft MSA before sending to ClearPeak.
5) Reporting: Naomi — please add a tracker in the Console for token usage alerts and set a cap that auto-notifies sales if they exceed 90% of the top-up.

If finance wants to carve out the discount amount for an exec-level signoff, flag it now — I expect revenue ops will be OK. Karthik, loop in pricing if needed.

I approve subject to the items above. Logan, send the conditional approval to Erin and include the Drive/DocuSign links.

-Marissa
VP Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: none

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Erin Gallagher <erin.gallagher@clearpeak.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearpeak.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, legal@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 Nov 2026 09:27:00 -07:00
Subject: ClearPeak POC — conditional approval and next steps

Hi Erin / Samir,

Great to move this forward. Executive summary: Redwood will approve a one-time 40,000 token credit top-up, a 21-day trial extension, and a one-month 15% introductory discount on the first bill after conversion — subject to the following conditions:

- Credits tied to project id: clearpeak-poc-2026 (admins only can change)
- Trial extension granted for 21 days only; we’ll reconvene for outcomes at the end of the window
- Discount applied only if ClearPeak signs a 12-month committed plan (minimum $12k/mo) within 30 days of POC completion
- Security: DPA signed, security questionnaire completed; legal will review the attached Draft MSA before execution
- Monitoring: Naomi and the Console team will set a usage alert at 90% of the top-up and reserve the right to throttle if unusual activity is detected

Links and attachments: Draft MSA (Drive) — https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3Cclearpeak-proj
DocuSign (MSA): https://app.docusign.com/clearpeak-rdw-msa-link
Internal concession calc (for your reference): internal-concession-calculation_v2.xlsx

If that all looks fine, we’ll send the DocuSign packet and the added credits will be applied within 24 hours of signed MSA and completed security intake. Please let me know if you want a quick call to walk through the success criteria and runbook.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Draft MSA_redwood_clearpeak_v1.pdf (attached)

From: Erin Gallagher <erin.gallagher@clearpeak.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearpeak.ai>, legal@clearpeak.ai
Date: Wed, 10 Nov 2026 17:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ClearPeak POC — conditional approval and next steps

Logan — this is great, thank you. We accept the conditions and will:
- Sign the MSA via DocuSign today
- Complete the security questionnaire within 48 hours
- Share the POC runbook and token burn scenarios by Friday

Can we kick off a technical onboarding call on Monday (Nov 15) at 10am PT? Samir will join from infra.

Appreciate the speed on this.

Best,
Erin

Attachments: none
